messages.subject: person$Item_time is not computed on the shiny server

Hi there,
another mirtCAT environment-related Question: I found some of the variables in the ''person " object not include information properly when it is deployed on the shiny-app server.
For example, person$terminated_successfully is always logi FALSE, and person$item_time has 0 value for all the items taken.
Any ideas why this is the case and possible solution?

Thanks,
Jungmin
